model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  Attitude =~ att_appealing + att_desirable +
              att_goodidea + att_pleasant
  PBC =~ pbc_barrier + pbc_could +
         pbc_resources
  SocialNorms =~ norms_d_many + norms_d_common +
                      norms_d_few + 
                 norms_i_consider + norms_i_bad +
                      norms_i_support

  Symbolism =~ symb_envresp + symb_modern
  AoC =~ aoc_transport + aoc_overstated + aoc_minor
  BEnv =~ ben_env_reduce + ben_env_shift + ben_env_nodiff
  
  Reactance =~ reactance_interfere + reactance_rulesharm + reactance_commongood + reactance_individual
  AntiIntel =~ antiintel_commonsense + antiintel_facts + antiintel_expertshelp

  Intention =~ nextv_bev + nextv_phev + nextv_icev


  # =======================================
  # Structural path
  # ======================================= 
  Intention ~ a*Attitude + PBC + SocialNorms + c1*Reactance + c2*AntiIntel
  Attitude ~ AoC + BEnv + Symbolism + b1*Reactance + b2*AntiIntel
  BEnv ~ AoC
  SocialNorms ~  Symbolism

  
  # Indirect, direct, total: Reactance/Anti-Intel -> Att -> Intention
  ind_reac := b1*a
  dir_react := c1
  tot_react := b1*a + c1
  
  ind_antiintel := b2*a
  dir_antiintel := c2
  tot_antiintel := b2*a + c2 

  # =======================================
  # Covariance path
  # ======================================= 
  Attitude ~~ PBC
  Attitude ~~ SocialNorms
  SocialNorms ~~ PBC

  SocialNorms ~~ AoC
  SocialNorms ~~ BEnv
  
  BEnv ~~ PBC
  BEnv ~~ Symbolism
  
  # New endo ~~ exo paths in the presence of dispositional accounts
  BEnv ~~ Reactance
  BEnv ~~ AntiIntel
  
  SocialNorms ~~ Reactance
  SocialNorms ~~ AntiIntel
  
  # In addition, all exo ~~ exo allowed with auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE
